title: Strawberry Poppy Seed Cream Cheese Muffins
description: Fresh strawberries, cream cheese chunks, and poppy seeds dress up this shortcut muffin recipe.
ingredients: 2 cups complete honey wheat pancake mix
0.75 cup Almond Breeze Vanilla or Vanilla Cashew blend Almondmilk
0.5 (8 ounce) package 1/3 less fat cream cheese, cut into 1/2-inch pieces

steps.text: Preheat oven to 375 degrees F and line 12 muffin cups with paper liners.
Stir together pancake mix, Almond Breeze, sugar, oil, extract, and poppy seeds in a medium bowl. Lightly stir in strawberries and cream cheese. Add strawberry jam and swirl lightly with a knife.
Spoon into prepared cups and bake for 20 to 25 minutes or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.
